title: `gh pr comment --attach` refuses `ghu_` tokens that the upload endpoint accepts

labels.name: priority-3
labels.description: Affects a small number of users or is largely cosmetic

labels.name: gh-pr
labels.description: relating to the gh pr command

body:
### Describe the bug

`gh` checks the token type before it builds the upload request, and the allowlist excludes `ghu_`. The attachment endpoint accepts a `ghu_` token. So `--attach` refuses a credential that works.

`internal/attachments/client.go`:

```go
var uploadTokenTypes = []gh.TokenType{
	gh.TokenTypeOAuth,          // gho_
	gh.TokenTypePersonalAccess, // ghp_
	gh.TokenTypeFineGrainedPAT, // github_pat_
}
```

`ghu_` is a GitHub App user-to-server token. It is the credential a GitHub Copilot cloud agent session holds, in `GITHUB_COPILOT_API_TOKEN`. So inside GitHub's own coding agent, `gh pr comment --attach` can never work, even though the same upload succeeds with the same token through `curl`.

### Steps to reproduce

With a `ghu_` token in `GH_TOKEN`, run `gh pr comment <n> --attach file.png`. It fails in the client, before any request is sent.

Then post the same file directly, with the same token:

```bash
curl -X POST "$GITHUB_UPLOADS_URL" \
  --url-query "name=e.png" --url-query "content_type=image/png" \
  --url-query "repository_id=$GITHUB_REPOSITORY_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/octet-stream" \
  -H "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28" \
  -H "Authorization: token $GH_TOKEN" \
  --data-binary @e.png
```

```
HTTP/2 201
{"url":"https://<host>/user-attachments/assets/<uuid>"}
```

### Expected vs actual

Expected: `--attach` uploads, because the server accepts the token.
Actual: `--attach` reports a credential fault for a credential the server accepts.

### Note on the scheme, for anyone who lands here

The endpoint wants `Authorization: token`, not `Authorization: Bearer`. `Bearer` answers `404 Not Found`, which reads as a missing endpoint rather than a wrong header. I mention it because it sent me after the wrong fault for days, and because GitHub's own built-in `github-pr-media` skill uses `Bearer`.

### What I ask for

Add `ghu_` to `uploadTokenTypes`. Then `--attach` works inside Copilot coding agent sessions with no configuration at all. I am happy to send the pull request if you would take it.
